# `morphir package registry sign-metadata`

- **Usage:** `morphir package registry sign-metadata <FLAGS>`

Sign a caller-authored TUF role with an explicit local key

## Flags
- **`--input <FILE>`** — Unsigned top-level TUF role JSON
- **`--key-file <FILE>`** — Explicit Ed25519 seed file used to sign this role
- **`--output <FILE>`** — New signed role envelope file
- **`--json`**
